h: Skit maker Gilmore claims Kai Cenat borrowed one of his ideas
p: A Nigerian skit maker known as Gilmore has reportedly claimed that streaming star Kai Cenat used an idea he had created earlier. The claim has set off debate among online content creators about credit and originality. Kai Cenat has not been reported to have responded.
more: Some creators online say ideas often overlap, while others are urging credit for original makers.
The post has drawn comments from fans on both sides.
